proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 3821 article gives Malayalam pacu, pai, paiṃ tender, fresh, moist, green; paca, paśa, paya moisture; paśima freshness, softness, moisture; pacca greenness, freshness; payir green corn; payiṅṅa unripe fruit, young areca nut; pāśi, pāśār, pāyal, pāyil, pāyi green stuff on stagnant…. The Malayalam survey form pacca “green” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
